title: Vampire Vape Koncept Catapult 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Catapult from Vampire Vape is a mouth-watering blend of sweet and juicy red cherries, sharp blackcurrants and a beguiling hint of warming aniseed on the exhale that makes this a super-smooth and satisfying vape you won’t want to put down. Vampire Vape’s new Koncept range brings more 100ml shortfills to their celebrated collection, offering sub-ohm vapers significantly longer-lasting versions of some of Vampire Vape’s most iconic e-liquids. All your favourites are here, including such legendary juices as Pinkman and Heisenberg. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. These shortfill e-liquids contain a ratio of 70VG/30PG which make them essential for use with higher-powered vape kits and pod kits, as most of these devices will use a coil below 1.0ohm (sub-ohm) resistance. At lower resistances coils are better equipped to handle the thicker VG ingredient of the e-liquid, and produce satisfying, dense clouds and fantastic flavour.
